name: Extensions - Awesome Pi Coding Agent
description: Firstpick's custom Pi coding agent themes. ... Passive token optimization for Pi sessions. Auto-optimizes large files (300+ lines) with no configuration required. ... Delegating task/subagent extension for Pi: foreground/background subagents, widgets, tmux observability, SDK fallback. ... YAML hook automation for the PI coding agent: tool guards, session hooks, prompts, notifications, and bash actions. ... Pi extension: open a GitHub-like git diff viewer in the browser.
